name: The Floating Lantern Bazaar
description: A bustling market suspended among clouds, stalls made of translucent glass shelves hold glowing lanterns that drift gently, merchants trade in shards of starlight and rainbow-colored fabrics.
prompt: A vibrant Floating Lantern Bazaar in the sky: translucent glass market stalls laden with floating lanterns emitting warm amber light, merchants wearing flowing robes exchange bundles of starlight and rainbow silk, clouds below create a soft backdrop, dynamic composition, luminous colors, magical realism style.
caption: Rise above the ordinary and wander the Floating Lantern Bazaar—where every stall sparkles with sky‑borne treasures ✨.
